result:
T-DG6-FE-D is built and its 1,000-initiative e2e passes. Two acceptance checks did not finish clean: `pnpm test` exited 1 in both locales, and `pnpm test:integration` was stopped by the harness before it finished. I can't report either as passed. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-D-frontend-ux-engineer.md`, and the changes are uncommitted. I finished at 17:53 UTC, about 11 minutes past the 2-hour limit, while waiting for the test suites.

**What was built:**
- **Global search:** a search box in the header and a `/search` page. It has record-type filters, chips and saved views. The stale state is separate from the empty state, and a missing "last updated" time shows as Unknown.
- **Saved views:** pick, save, save as new, rename, set default, delete, and share only for holders of `saved_view.share`. The auditor can apply views but is offered no write and sends none.
- **Filter chips, breadcrumbs (`<bdi>`-isolated, `aria-current`) and the help panel** (topics per screen, Arabic marked provisional).
- **Initiative register:** it now sorts, filters and pages on the server through `listInitiatives`. Column choices are stored in saved views, and the old per-browser choice is read once and never written.
- **The eight ADR-0057 §10 refusal texts** in English (verbatim) and Arabic (provisional).

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| DG5 historical validator, start and end | exit 0 |
| `pnpm -r build` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm lint` | exit 0 |
| prettier check over all files | exit 0 |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0, 932 operations |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` | exit 0 on re-run. The first attempt exited 137: `apps/api` ran out of memory while the other suites ran. |
| e2e `p6-register-1000.spec.ts` | 6/6 passed (en and ar) |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | **exit 1.** Every test passed (2734 unit-node, 1837 unit-web, 259 formula with 2 skipped), but Vitest reported one worker timeout error. |
| `pnpm test`, C.UTF-8 | **exit 1.** 9 failures, all timeouts or missing elements at load average about 25. Re-running exactly those files: 127/127 web and 6/6 node passed. |
| `pnpm test:integration` | **Not completed.** Stopped at the 60-minute limit with 154 files passed and 3 files failing (5 tests): `webhooks`, `assistant/conversations` and `contract/response-validation`. |

My change touches only `apps/web/**`, so those three integration failures can't come from it. I couldn't re-run them to tell load from an existing defect. Both suites need a re-run on a quieter machine.

The e2e budget is 300 s per test. The slowest measured run was 35.2 s at load average 14–20, so the budget is about 8x.

Earlier e2e and test runs found three real product defects, now fixed:
- **Rows remounting:** table rows were re-created on every render.
- **Header search box collision:** it added a second `<form>`, search field and "Search" button to every page, which broke 13 existing tests. It is now a search region without a form.
- **Wrong "Changed, not saved" label:** it showed right after a successful save.

**Decisions for you:**
- **Files outside my ownership.** I changed these so the screens are reachable and the register works:
  - `pages/portfolio/InitiativeRegister.tsx` (new) and `PortfolioPage.tsx`;
  - `components/Page.tsx`, `app/Shell.tsx`, `app/router.tsx` and `i18n/index.ts`;
  - nine keys appended to both `problems.json` files. FE-A was meant to add the slice H codes, but they were missing.

  Please accept or move these lines at merge. Expect conflicts only where other FE tasks also append to the same files.
- **Register behaviour changes.** Only server sort keys can be sorted now: code, name, planned end and last changed. The browser-side search across every column is replaced by the server's code-or-name filter. Owners, proposed rank and selection can't be hidden any more, because a saved view can't store them. Keeping them sortable or hideable would need new API sort keys or registry columns.

**Other gaps:**
- The transformations list and the nine P2 register lists still sort and filter in the browser. Moving them onto saved views is mechanical but touches pages outside my section, so I left it as a follow-up.
- The e2e stack runs no worker, so the search index is never filled and search there always shows the stale state. QA-B (A12) needs a stack that runs the index jobs.
- FE-D2 still owns draft recovery, compare-and-reapply, inline edit and the six-state test.

No pending-list, contract, migration or dependency changes. No existing text was made untrue.

Screenshots in English and Arabic are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-FE-D-evidence/screenshots/`. The other logs are in the same evidence folder.
